title: To be honest, I have no idea...
content_text:
To be honest, I have no idea how to spend my weekend.
Right now I'm just lying around listening to this novel — I don't even know why I'm so hooked on it.
I've basically been lying around all day — not feeling great, and I don't really have the will to do anything else.
